title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA FOUNDATION ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Foundation Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and matters necessary for the enforcement thereof.

Article 2 (Approval for establishment of branches) When the Foundation intends to obtain approval for establishment of a branch pursuant to Article 4(2) of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval stating the following matters to the Minister of Foreign Affairs <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  1. Name of a branch;
  2. Seat of a branch;
  3. Reasons for establishment;
  4. The scheduled date of establishment;
  5. Organizations and fixed numbers of personnel of branches;
  6. Details of business affairs of branches.

Article 3 (Operation and management of Korea Foundation) (1) The Foundation shall manage the Korea Foundation (hereinafter referred to as the "Fund") created pursuant to Article 14 of the Act by establishing a separate account.
  (2) The Foundation shall prepare a plan for the operation and management of the Fund for the following year and submit it to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and obtain approval thereof by November 30 of each year. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  (3) The plan for investment and management of the Fund under paragraph (2) shall include the following matters:
  1. A plan for fund raising by financial resources;
  2. Plan for fund use by project and financial resource;
  3. Details explaining purpose of use of the Fund.

Article 4 (Grant of contributions) (1) When the Government intends to grant contributions to the Foundation pursuant to Article 15 of the Act, the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall appropriate them in the budget and grant them. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  (2) When the budget for contributions under paragraph (1) is finalized, the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall notify the Foundation thereof. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  (3) When the Foundation intends to receive contributions, it shall submit an application for contributions to the Minister of Foreign Affairs, along with a quarterly business plan and a budget execution plan. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  (4) Upon receipt of an application under paragraph (3), the Minister of Foreign Affairs shall, when he or she deems that the quarterly business plan and budget execution plan are appropriate, grant contributions accordingly. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 5 (Fund-raising of international exchange endowments) (1) The subject matters and amount of fund-raising of international exchange by the Foundation pursuant to Article 16(2) of the Act shall be as specified in Appendix 1. <Amended on Dec. 4, 2018>
  (2) The Minister of Foreign Affairs shall annually receive the written status of fund-raising and accumulation of international exchange endowments under paragraph (1) from the Foundation and notify the Minister of the Interior and Safety by January 31 of the following year. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 6 (Gratuitous lending of national property) Where the Foundation gratuitously lends State property to the Foundation or allows the Foundation to use or profit from State property under Article 17 of the Act, the details, conditions, procedures, etc. thereof shall be determined by a contract between the management agency of the relevant State property and the Foundation.

Article 7 (Application for approval of borrowing of funds) (1) When the Foundation intends to obtain approval for borrowing of funds pursuant to Article 18(2) of the Act, it shall submit an application for approval stating the following matters to the Minister of Foreign Affairs <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  1. Purpose of borrowing;
  2. Amount of borrowed money;
  3. Lender;
  4. Terms and conditions of borrowing;
  5. Method and deadline for repayment of borrowed funds;
  6. Other matters necessary for borrowing and repayment of funds.
  (2) The cumulative amount of borrowed funds under paragraph (1) shall not exceed half of the annual budget of the Foundation excluding the Fund.
  (3) When the Minister of Foreign Affairs intends to approve the borrowing of funds from the Foundation, he or she shall consult with the Minister of Finance and Economy in advance. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Jan. 29, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 8 (Approval of business plan and budget bill) When the Foundation intends to obtain approval of a business plan and a budget bill pursuant to Article 20 of the Act, it shall submit its business plan and budget bill for the following year to the Minister of Foreign Affairs by November 30 of each year, along with the following documents. <Amended on Jun. 9, 1997; Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 5, 2021>
  1. An estimated statement of financial position and specifications annexed thereto;
  2. An estimated statement of profits and losses and specifications annexed thereto.

Article 9 (Report on settlement of accounts) When the Foundation submits a written settlement of accounts of revenues and expenditures for each business year to the Minister of Foreign Affairs pursuant to Article 21 of the Act, it shall attach the following documents to the Foundation <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013; Jan. 5, 2021>
  1. A comparison table of the business plan for the relevant year and the results of its execution;
  2. Statement of financial position and statement of profits and losses for the relevant year;
  3. The written opinion of a certified public accountant designated by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and a written opinion of an auditor of the Foundation;
  4. Other documents verifying the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 10 (Establishment of affiliated institutions) The Foundation may establish an affiliated institution necessary for conducting profit-making business with approval from the Minister of Foreign Affairs. <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>

Article 11 (Approval of internal regulations) When the Foundation intends to enact or amend the internal regulations concerning the following matters, it shall obtain approval from the Minister of Foreign Affairs <Amended on Jan. 29, 1999; Mar. 23, 2013>
  1. Matters concerning the organization and fixed number of personnel of the Foundation;
  2. Matters concerning remuneration and service of executive officers and employees;
  3. Matters concerning the operation and management of funds;
  4. Matters concerning accounting, property, and commodity management.

Article 11-2 (Processing of personally identifiable information) The Foundation may process data containing resident registration numbers, passport numbers, driver's license numbers, or alien registration numbers under Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act, if it is inevitable to conduct affairs concerning international exchange under Article 6 of the Act.
  [This Article Added on Jan. 6, 2012]

Article 12 (Criteria for imposition of administrative fines) Standards for imposing administrative fines prescribed in Article 26-2(1) of the Act are prescribed as Appendix 2.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Dec. 4, 2018]
